name: Model footprint
responsibility: Relates a local source branch change to canonical modules
description: The command passes explicit local source refs and selected architecture to the existing history interface. Proposal comparisons use their identified baseline. With --fail-outside and a draft, it exits 1 when the commits changed a module that the draft does not name, so a ticket merge without a pull request has a gate like the out-of-plan fail mode of the pull-request Action. A module bound to a directory, or to a .csproj project, fails the gate only when no other changed module is bound inside it, because it changes with each of them; the Action does not apply this exception. Without a draft it refuses the option.
